_comment: Grants a triggered ability to the next card you play that deals arcane damage. The filter asks what the card DOES (CARD_HAS_EFFECT reads its own JSON). The granted ability said DESTROY a frozen card in their arsenal and was authored as PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM, which BOTTOMS it -- the card survives, in their deck, to be drawn again. The comment here already claimed it destroyed one, so the gap was invisible to a reader. Now DESTROY_ARSENAL. Destroying a FROZEN card is still approximated as destroying an arsenal card: frozen state is not tracked, so this remains more permissive than printed. Quell 1 is a printed keyword.
